title: Eigenvector distribution of random matrices under critical finite-rank deformations
summary: We investigate the eigenvector distribution at the soft edge for Gaussian random matrices with finite-rank deformations, in the critical regime of BBP transition. For finite-rank deformations of the GOE and GUE with critical spikes, we find that the squared overlap between a leading eigenvector and a spike, rescaled by \(N^{1/3}\), converges weakly to the negative reciprocal of the derivative of an Airy-Green function evaluated at the corresponding soft-edge root.
